text: Tool 1: Positions. Each letter has a position from 1 to 26. A is 1, B is 2, and so on up to Z at 26. You shouldn't count on your fingers in the exam. Use anchor letters instead. Remember E-J-O-T-Y: E is 5, J is 10, O is 15, T is 20, Y is 25. From any anchor, you are at most two steps from your target letter. For example, R is two before T, so R is 18.
